about: This prototype concentrates real structure and sample resources in East of England so demos can walk Featured EMS → Greater Essex → districts without claiming UK-wide completeness.
Greater Essex Music Hub includes Essex Music Service, Music-on-Sea (Southend) and Thurrock Music Service.

children.name: Greater Essex Music Hub
description: Greater Essex Music Hub brings together Essex Music Service, Music-on-Sea (Southend) and Thurrock Music Service to support schools, young people and communities.

about: Greater Essex Music Hub is a partnership of organisations, including the music services of Essex, Southend-on-Sea and Thurrock, and schools. It helps children and young people from all backgrounds and every part of the hub’s area to deepen their engagement with music.
Essex Music Service (Essex County Council) is the Hub Lead Organisation.
Contact (published on Essex Music Service contact page): 0333 013 8953 · musichub@essex.gov.uk. EMS headquarters postal address is not published on that page.
schoolsEducation: The hub works with schools across Essex, Southend-on-Sea and Thurrock. Curriculum partnerships, specialist tuition and CPD are published on the Greater Essex Music Hub and partner service websites.
training: Teacher CPD and workforce support are listed under Opportunities for Schools on the Greater Essex Music Hub website.

about: Tendring sits within the Essex Music Service delivery area for Greater Essex Music Hub.

Tendring Community Music Centre offers a combination of individual, small group, and ensemble music provision in Manningtree on Saturday mornings during term-time, open to students from across the Tendring and Colchester areas. Students aged 5–18 are welcome.

Offer includes All in Band, Brass Ensemble, rock/soul/pop band, Junior Wind Ensemble, and groups for theory, aural and musicianship. Sessions run Saturdays (term time only) 8:30am–1pm at Manningtree High School, Colchester Road, Lawford, Manningtree CO11 2BW. Published contact name: Tess Greene; published centre email: sam.geden@essex.gov.uk.

children.name: Music-on-Sea (Southend)
description: Music-on-Sea is the music education hub for Southend-on-Sea, working as part of Greater Essex Music Hub alongside Essex Music Service and Thurrock Music Service.

about: Southend Music Service ‘Music on Sea’ is committed to supporting the delivery of and providing high musical opportunities to children and young people across Southend City Council.

Vision (published): all children and young people should have the opportunity to learn to sing, play an instrument and create music together, as well as progress their musical interests and talent, including through professional pathways.
Music on Sea aims to support schools and other education settings to deliver high quality music education, including opportunities in and outside of school.
Contact (published): musiconsea@southend.gov.uk · 01702 215861. Office open weekdays, standard working hours. Postal address is not published on the Contact Us page.
schoolsEducation: At Music on Sea we provide tuition for children and young people in schools across Southend. This takes place weekly in term time and includes a wide range of musical specialisms and whole class music teaching.
Published family cost note: £30 per instrument per term — ask your school or contact Music on Sea for more information.

description: South West listings start with the West of England Music Hub — the combined hub for Bristol and the surrounding authorities (formerly Bristol Music Hub plus partner LA services).
Hub Lead: Bristol Beacon. Delivery partner for Bath & North East Somerset, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire: West of England Music and Arts (WEMA).

about: From September 2024, Arts Council England appointed Bristol Beacon as Hub Lead Organisation for the West of England Music Hub, in partnership with WEMA.
This succeeds the former Bristol-only Music Hub and brings Bath & North East Somerset, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire into one regional hub under the National Plan for Music Education.

description: West of England Music Hub covers Bristol, Bath & North East Somerset, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire.
Bristol Beacon (Hub Lead) works with West of England Music and Arts (WEMA), who continue to deliver music education in the three authorities around Bristol.

about: Bristol Beacon has led music education for Bristol since 2011 (formerly Bristol Music Hub). From September 2024 it leads the wider West of England Music Hub under the National Plan for Music Education.
WEMA remains the delivery partner for Bath & North East Somerset, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire — the organisations work as one regional hub, not a single merged service brand.
schoolsEducation: School curriculum support, instrumental and vocal pathways, ensembles, workshops and inclusive music programmes across the four local authorities.
Bristol schools connect via Bristol Beacon Creative Learning; BANES, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire schools via WEMA Music Hub services.
